0022600004.text: Both the Minnesota Timberwolves and the Miami Heat open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with Minnesota visiting as the away team. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota after Achilles surgery, while Miami's Vladislav Goldin is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. In 2025-26, the Timberwolves won the season series 2-0, most recently beating Miami 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026.
